lines: Heather to the knee. Bees, mostly. And me.
npcHeath.greet.speaker: npcHeath

lines: Three boars tear up the heather. The bees go hungry.
npcHeath.offer.speaker: npcHeath

lines: Still rooting. I can hear them from here.
npcHeath.notReady.speaker: npcHeath

lines: The heather will grow back. Here, two draughts.
npcHeath.thanks.speaker: npcHeath
